## Purpose
`dashboard.ts` and `projects.ts` are the two "entry" modules the guards call out by name: the single import site for one command-wrapper surface (dashboard-wide fetches, project-registry commands respectively). Both open with a header comment stating explicitly that components must not call `call()` directly and must import from this file instead. Both wrap every backend `call()`/`subscribe()` invocation in a small typed function whose name states the verb (`fetch*`, `on*`, register/hide/unhide/unregister), and both group related exports under `// --- Section name ---` banner comments that name the spec/wave that introduced the block.

## Convention
Folder: apps/dashboard/src/lib/** · Extension: .ts · Files of this role in this subproject: 2
Every exported struct-shaped entry pairs one `export interface Foo` (the camelCase, UI-facing shape) with the wire call. When the backend's snake_case field names need remapping to camelCase, the file also declares a private `interface RawFoo` (unexported) plus a `toFoo`/inline `.map()` translator — never expose the raw snake_case shape to callers. Command functions take the same explicit primitive params the backend command declares (never a loose options bag) and return `Promise<T>`, mirroring the backend's fail-open contract with a doc comment when relevant ("Always resolves", "Fail-open").

## How to apply
A new dashboard-wide command wrapper goes into `lib/dashboard.ts` under a new `// --- <feature> ---` banner near the bottom of the file, next to the section it most relates to (or a fresh banner for an unrelated feature). A new project-registry-scoped command goes into `lib/projects.ts` following the raw/public pairing already established there. Both files import `call`/`subscribe` only from `@/lib/api-client` — never construct a URL or `fetch` directly.

## Examples
Ref: apps/dashboard/src/lib/projects.ts
```ts
export interface ProjectEntry {
  /** Absolute filesystem path. Doubles as the entry's identity. */
  path: string;
  /** Display label — the trailing segment of `path`. */
  name: string;
  /** ISO-8601 timestamp the entry was registered (UTC). */
  addedAt: string;
  hidden: boolean;
  parent: string | null;
}

interface RawProjectEntry {
  path: string;
  name: string;
  added_at: string;
  hidden: boolean;
  parent: string | null;
}

function toProjectEntry(raw: RawProjectEntry): ProjectEntry {
  return {
    path: raw.path,
    name: raw.name,
    addedAt: raw.added_at,
    hidden: raw.hidden,
    parent: raw.parent,
  };
}
```

Ref: apps/dashboard/src/lib/dashboard.ts
```ts
export function fetchSessions(repoPath: string, limit?: number): Promise<SessionRow[]> {
  return call<SessionRow[]>("dashboard_sessions", { repoPath, limit });
}
```
